Name: (CP) Falling Metal Pipe Hammer Sound
Author: PixxiePerfect
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Changes the slam sound effect that plays during the special right-click attack for club/hammer-type weapons to the iconic falling metal pipe sound.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]1. Download the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]2. Download the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and put it into your mods folder.[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]3. Download and unzip this mod, and put it into your mods folder.[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]4. Enjoy![/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Abagaianye]Abagaianye[/url] for helping me troubleshoot basic code stuff, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch?gameId=1303]BogWyytch[/url] for the awesome mod-making help channel in her Discord![/size][/color]

Manifest.Name: Falling Metal Pipe Hammer Slam
Manifest.Description: Changes the sound effect for club/hammer slams to the falling metal pipe sound. That's it.
